decision_rule_reachability.reason: Cascade precedence is clean: MEASUREMENT_INVALID (null) -> TAU_RULE_INFEASIBLE (BLOCKED) -> BLIND_SURVIVES/BLIND_FAILS; no earlier branch subsumes the science branches, and the invalidity/infeasibility conjuncts are expected-pass drift guards on identical frozen banks (parent run_output.json corroborates every hardcoded tripwire: reincluded gids, gold screened/reincl vectors {G3:T,G2:F,G1:T,ALT:T}, retrieval tau=0.4156/mu=0.0005 with TFRAME_DOMINATES_G3 on both supersets and all retrieval TEST gates false). Thresholds are integer-attainable on the decided set (20 OOS / 40 app: FA<=0.10 means <=2 executed OOS, COV>=0.50 means >=20 executed app, UP_excl>=0.85 attainable at abstOOS=18/abstApp=3 giving 0.8571 — exactly the published tau=0.3333 vector). Both science branches are arithmetically live at the emitted tau*: static monotonicity shows SELECT pooled_false_accept is non-increasing in tau, so argmax-slack with the higher-tau tie-break deterministically emits the highest SELECT-feasible tau (published complete feasible list tops at 0.6; tau* != 0.2727 and != 0.3333). On G3 reincluded TEST the decision then reduces to a single sharp, genuinely open event: SURVIVES requires abstApp==3 at tau* (then abstOOS>=18>=5.667*3 keeps UP>=0.85 and FA<=2/20=0.10 holds by monotone FA); FAILS triggers if any 4th app row scores below tau* (abstOOS<=20 makes UP>=0.85 arithmetically impossible for abstApp>=4). Accepted evidence does not exclude either configuration (SELECT app coverage published 1.0 at all 9 feasible taus; TEST at 0.3333 has exactly 3 abstained app). BLIND_INERT collapse is pre-handled as VALID gate-false. taus is non-empty whenever fit-pool bars pass (SELECT 34+60 rows), so the rule always emits a tau* and cannot crash on an empty best.
